    MedCore.Session (med_ex v0.1.0)

    Copy Markdown View Source

    Immutable live clinical transport session aggregate and pure reducer (step/2).

    A Session owns live participants, WebRTC connection attempts (connection_id), transient preview interruptions, independent recording continuity, and device acquisitions (acquisition_id). It can outlast individual browser reconnects and supports standalone capture with encounter_ref: nil and no connected peer.

    Types

    acquisition_id()

    @type acquisition_id() :: String.t()

    connection_id()

    @type connection_id() :: String.t()

    continuity_state()

    @type continuity_state() :: :observed_continuous | :observed_gap | :unknown

    effect()

    @type effect() ::
  {:emit_fact, atom(), map()}
  | {:publish_ui, atom(), map()}
  | {:start_lossless_capture, String.t(), acquisition_id()}
  | {:append_audit_log, map()}

    encounter_ref()

    @type encounter_ref() :: String.t() | nil

    event()

    @type event() ::
  {:peer_connected,
   %{
     :peer_id => String.t(),
     :connection_id => connection_id(),
     :role => atom(),
     :t_ms => non_neg_integer(),
     optional(:stream_id) => String.t()
   }}
  | {:peer_disconnected,
     %{
       :peer_id => String.t(),
       :connection_id => connection_id(),
       :t_ms => non_neg_integer(),
       optional(:stream_id) => String.t()
     }}
  | {:acquisition_started,
     %{
       acquisition_id: acquisition_id(),
       stream_id: String.t(),
       t_ms: non_neg_integer()
     }}
  | {:capture_completed,
     %{
       acquisition_id: acquisition_id(),
       artifact_sha256: String.t(),
       interval_ms: {non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer()},
       continuity: continuity_state(),
       delivery_id: String.t(),
       t_ms: non_neg_integer()
     }}

    integrity_report()

    @type integrity_report() :: %{
  :subject => integrity_subject(),
  :interval_ms => {non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer()},
  :continuity => continuity_state(),
  optional(:reasons) => [atom()]
}

    integrity_subject()

    @type integrity_subject() ::
  {:preview_stream, String.t()} | {:recording_artifact, acquisition_id()}

    session_id()

    @type session_id() :: String.t()

    t()

    @type t() :: %MedCore.Session{
  acquisitions: %{required(acquisition_id()) => map()},
  audit_seq: non_neg_integer(),
  connections: %{required(connection_id()) => map()},
  encounter_ref: encounter_ref(),
  id: session_id(),
  integrity_reports: %{required(integrity_subject()) => integrity_report()},
  participants: %{required(String.t()) => map()},
  preview_interruptions: [map()],
  streams: %{required(String.t()) => MedCore.StreamSpec.t()},
  topology: MedCore.Profile.topology()
}
